name: ISO/IEC 27001
description: International standard for Information Security Management Systems (ISMS) Annex A security controls.

controls.title: Network Security - Access Control & Boundary Filtering
controls.remediation: For {vendor}, isolate network management domains and filter unauthorized connections using access control lists.

controls.title: Use of Cryptography - Enforce Strong Encryption in Transit
controls.remediation: For {vendor}, enable TLS-encrypted communications (HTTPS) for all graphical and web management endpoints.

controls.title: Application Security - Disable Insecure Cleartext Protocols
controls.remediation: For {vendor}, eliminate unencrypted Telnet and plaintext command channels across all network infrastructure.

controls.title: Secure Authentication - Centralized Identity & AAA Framework
controls.remediation: For {vendor}, govern privileged access through centralized AAA authentication linked to corporate directory services.

controls.title: Configuration Management - Minimum Credential Length Policy
controls.remediation: For {vendor}, enforce security baseline standards requiring passwords of at least 12 characters.

controls.title: Logging - Recording and Central Review of Event Logs
controls.remediation: For {vendor}, transmit audit trail events to dedicated, secure central logging facilities.

controls.title: Clock Synchronization for Accurate Security Event Correlation
controls.remediation: For {vendor}, ensure uniform time synchronization using reliable network time protocol (NTP) servers.

controls.title: Access Control - Explicit Authorization and Warning Notice
controls.remediation: For {vendor}, present a legal warning banner specifying conditions of authorized usage prior to session establishment.

controls.title: Installation and Use of Secure Protocols - SSH Version 2
controls.remediation: For {vendor}, require SSHv2 for all console and remote terminal management sessions.

controls.title: Management of Technical Vulnerabilities - Disable Insecure HTTP
controls.remediation: For {vendor}, reduce vulnerability surface by terminating unencrypted HTTP administration daemons.
